name: How often should stucco be re-coated?

mainEntity.name: How often should stucco be re-coated?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency for stucco re-coating depends on several factors, including climate, original stucco quality, and exposure to environmental stressors like sun and rain. Generally, a stucco finish can last 15-20 years before needing a re-coat. However, if you notice fading, minor hairline cracks, or chalking when touched, it might be time to consider re-coating sooner. Regular inspections can help determine the optimal timing to ensure your stucco remains in good condition and protected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco typically needs re-coating every 15-20 years, but signs like fading or minor cracks may indicate an earlier need.
